item.description: There are new rules for refrigerated trucks at the Coolgardie rest area. A sign has been installed at the Coolgardie heavy vehicle rest area that states “No parking of refrigerated trucks”. item.title: Air reservoirs contamination: The hidden cause of downtime in modern fleets
item.description: The electronically actuated DumpMaster EXT-50 unit. Image: GP Truck Products As modern air brake systems evolve, workshops are quietly facing an old problem of contamination inside air reservoirs that refuses to disappear. While compressors and dryers have improved dramatically over the years, contamination made up of water, emulsified oil, carbon and sludge continues to accumulate in tanks and migrate downstream into valves and braking components. item.title: Main South Road duplication opens to traffic as part of $810.4 million project
item.description: Stage 2 of the Main South Road duplication runs from Aldinga to Sellicks Beach. item.title: Road freight industry blasts plan to scrap fuel tax credits
item.description: Trucking businesses have already had to pay a 19 per cent increase in fuel tax over the last three years. Image: LightItUp/stock.adobe.com Trucking bosses have been quick to slam the proposed abolishment of the Fuel Tax Credit (FTC) for heavy vehicle operators by the Productivity Commission (PC). The PC argues that by lowering the cost of diesel for trucking operators the credits make it cheaper to burn fossil fuels, therefore reducing the incentives to switch to alternative, cleaner fuels.
